understanding.goal_understanding: The goal was to progress through every level by moving each selectable piece onto a goal tile marked '+'. When multiple goals existed, all had to be occupied simultaneously for the level to report WIN, completing the game.
understanding.mechanics_understanding: Pieces moved one grid cell per directional action using pixel coordinates spaced by 3. Adjacent pushable blocks could be pushed while moving, whereas walls and boundaries could block movement, though blocked hints were not always definitive. Multiple selectable pieces could be controlled by CLICKing their exact displayed pixel position; switching between pieces was necessary to place all pieces on the goals.

understanding.goal_understanding: The goal was to progress through every level by moving each selectable piece onto a goal tile marked '+'. When multiple goals existed, all had to be occupied simultaneously for the level to report WIN, completing the game.
understanding.mechanics_understanding: Pieces moved one grid cell per directional action using pixel coordinates spaced by 3. Adjacent pushable blocks could be pushed while moving, whereas walls and boundaries could block movement, though blocked hints were not always definitive. Multiple selectable pieces could be controlled by CLICKing their exact displayed pixel position; switching between pieces was necessary to place all pieces on the goals.
